findings.desc: concept-cleanup: done-effects.ts was modified by B-6974 but 5 comments still say story-advance.ts is the coordinator/caller (lines 8, 35-36, 53, 220, 315). After B-6974 transition-orchestrator.ts is the direct caller, not story-advance.ts. Specifically: (1) header: story-advance.ts now delegates to the two exported functions; (2) layering: shares the layer with story-advance.ts / story-advance imports done-effects; (3) line 53: checkMainDivergence stays imported in story-advance.ts; (4) runDonePreMergeGate JSDoc: story-advance.ts calls this; (5) applyDoneMergeEffects JSDoc: story-advance.ts calls this.

concept-cleanup: story-advance.ts-as-direct-coordinator 概念在 transition-effects.ts / summary.ts / flow-stability-smoke.ts 中有 7 处残留注释。F-001 fix 更新了 done-effects.ts 和 phase-gates.ts，但 (1) transition-effects.ts 行 6/8/19/25 仍称 story-advance.ts 为直接调用方（"story-advance.ts now delegates to these functions" / "story-advance imports transition-effects"），应改为 transition-orchestrator.ts；(2) summary.ts 行 242 注释 "Used by story-advance.ts after successful DONE transition" 应改为 transition-orchestrator.ts；(3) flow-stability-smoke.ts 行 3051/3139 注释仍称 story-advance.ts 是 DONE gate 的调用方。这 3 个文件不在 B-6974 diff 内，B-6974 漏更新。

concept-cleanup: 576ede76 corrected 18 stale story-advance-as-coordinator comments but missed 3 residuals: (1) done-effects.ts:352 says [but triggered from story-advance] should say transition-orchestrator; (2) reviewer-list.ts:11 says [story-advance REVIEW echo] but REVIEW echo now lives in transition-effects.ts:buildNextSteps; (3) cli-engine.ts:1594 says [story-advance can call it the same way for onPhaseChange] but onPhaseChange is now handled by transition-orchestrator via runPhaseChangeHooks, not cli-engine buildHookEnvLocal
